title: Way to expensive for what it gives you
body: It’s just a habit tracker, but expensive. When you try it it says they’ll use CBT tools, the only ones I see are “prizes” which are images which say how many days you’ve been using it, and alarms. When you try it they guide you with the 4-78 breathing technique, but that’s not inside the app. It’s just to trick you… I wrote an email complaining, they never answer. Don’t spend your money here, there are cheaper options that do the same
